original_question: Problem 7.7 (S. Vũ Ngo.c). Is the singular Bohr-Sommerfeld formal power series in ~ a spectral invariant?
target_in_paper: Problem 7.7 (S. Vũ Ngọc.) in Section 7.2, “Inverse problem for quantum integrable systems”; in the v1 PDF with page numbers this is the corresponding Problem 6.7 in Section 6.2 on page 48. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))
correct_elements: Your draft matches the paper’s official problem essentially verbatim and correctly attributes it to S. Vũ Ngọc. It also uses the later arXiv/HTML numbering, where this appears as Problem 7.7 in the quantisation/inverse-spectral section. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))
missing_details: It does not say that the question is posed specifically inside the inverse spectral programme for semitoric systems, immediately after Conjecture 7.5 and Problem 7.6. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))

It omits the semitoric context: in the paper, a semitoric system is an integrable system all of whose singularities are nondegenerate and of elliptic or focus type, with J proper and generating a Hamiltonian S^1-action. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))

It does not mention that the relevant singularity is focus-focus: the surrounding text ties the question to the focus-focus critical value and to singular Bohr-Sommerfeld rules for focus-focus singularities. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))

It leaves the meaning of 'spectral invariant' implicit; in this section the intended notion is 'determined by / recoverable from the semiclassical joint spectrum'. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))

It does not identify the relevant spectrum: for the semitoric inverse problem, the paper uses the semiclassical joint spectrum of the quantized pair (Ĵ_ħ, Ĥ_ħ), i.e. pairs (λ, ν) with λ an eigenvalue of Ĵ_ħ and ν an eigenvalue of Ĥ_ħ on the λ-eigenspace, as ħ → 0. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))

It does not say that the formal series is the one appearing in the singular Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization rule, rather than an arbitrary formal power series in ħ. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))

It omits the motivating purpose stated by the paper: this is presented as an intermediate question toward computing the Taylor series invariant directly from the spectrum at the focus-focus critical value. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))
refined_question: For a quantum semitoric system F = (J, H)—where semitoric means that all singularities are nondegenerate and of elliptic or focus-focus type, J is proper, and J generates a Hamiltonian S^1-action—fix a focus-focus critical value c0. Consider the formal power series in ħ that appears in the singular Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization rule near c0. Is this formal power series determined by the semiclassical joint spectrum of the quantized pair (Ĵ_ħ, Ĥ_ħ), i.e. by the set of pairs (λ, ν) with λ an eigenvalue of Ĵ_ħ and ν an eigenvalue of Ĥ_ħ on the λ-eigenspace, as ħ → 0? ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))
justification: The draft is targeting the exact official open problem, namely Problem 7.7. The nearby text shows that it is not an isolated question about arbitrary formal series: it is introduced as a 'very natural' intermediate step after Problem 7.6 on recovering the Taylor series invariant of semitoric systems from the spectrum at a focus-focus critical value, and it explicitly points back to Problem 7.3 on singular Bohr-Sommerfeld rules for focus-focus singularities. Conjecture 7.5 supplies the intended spectral framework—recovery from the semiclassical joint spectrum of a quantum semitoric system—while the earlier semitoric definition supplies the hidden hypotheses. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/abs/1804.03737))
